text:
alex: quick follow-up to the canary RFC - proposing a lightweight 'sentinel' that owns probe cadence and fallback triggers. sketched a few variants, want quick reactions.
jamie: nice. single sentinel per-cluster or per-tenant? big tradeoff.
alex: per-tenant = better isolation but many state machines. per-cluster = simpler but bigger blast radius.
tanya: what about per-tenant control plane + shared probe workers? sentinel makes decisions, workers execute probes. keeps probe cost down.
ben: if a sentinel crashes, we need deterministic election and lease TTL. how do we recover state?
hilary: TTL + renewal and short backoff. new leader should replay a compact directive log.
jamie: replay adds complexity. make decisions idempotent: append-only directives with seq numbers so replay is safe.
tanya: agreed. decisions = {seq, decision, meta}. apply only seq > last_applied.
alex: proto sketch for directives: message Directive { uint64 seq; string kind; string target; map<string,string> meta; }
ben: runtime latency concern: proxy must be able to fallback locally without waiting for sentinel. data plane should have preloaded conservative policies.
hilary: split control vs data plane. data plane enforces preloaded triggers (e.g., p95>300ms OR errors>2%) and sentinel tunes thresholds and records rollouts.
ajex: (typo) alex: also need sticky vs ephemeral switches. sticky: until manual revert. ephemeral: auto-revert after stabilization window.
jamie: propose simple JSON DSL for fallback policy: {"trigger":{"metric":"latency.p95","op":">","value":300},"action":{"type":"route","variant":"v1-fallback","sticky":false,"cooldown_s":300}}
ben: who authorizes DSL? product writes policies, runtime validates. infra needs validation hooks.
tanya: runtime provides validator + safe defaults. product policies must pass static checks (no immediate 100% switch without canary).
hilary: enforce rollout constraints: canary window, max fraction, progression rate (e.g., start 1%, double every 10m up to 50%). encoded in rollout plan.
alex: telemetry: sentinel emits compact events: probe-id, seq, decision, reason-code, metric-snapshot. avoid high-cardinality.
jamie: also emit explain traces for rollbacks and link to span ids for debugging.
ben: cost note: adaptive probing. scale probe-rate proportional to variant traffic; cold variants probed sparsely. add TTL cache for health results to avoid probe storms.
tanya: yes. probe worker model + adaptive algorithm in proposal.
hilary: operational mode: quarantine-mode where automatic escalations pause and only manual actions allowed during risky infra changes.
alex: deployment flow: 1) author rollout plan + policy 2) schedule pilot 3) sentinel monitors + emits directives 4) data plane enforces fast fallback 5) telemetry + annotator for ops.
jamie: CI items: policy linter, unit tests for DSL, e2e with fake probe fleet.
ben: edge case: split-brain leases under partition. recommendation: region-local sentinels with local leader election; global orchestrator for audit and eventual convergence.
tanya: region-local buys availability; global auditor ensures consistency eventually.
hilary: good tradeoff.
alex: action items: jamie -> formalize DSL + linter; ben -> lease + replay semantics doc; tanya -> probe worker + adaptive probing design; hilary -> quarantine-mode + rollout constraint policy. I'll draft a short RFC addendum with directive proto and DSL examples.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: rfc-addendum/dir-proto v0.1 -> staging (started) :rocket:
jamie: syncing tomorrow 10am. ping @tanya @ben to bring examples.
ben: noted, thanks everyone.
